Alex (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands — drop concise questions about mission/positioning/market.
Jordan (Growth): Need a one-liner for sales decks that contrasts us with cloud endpoints.
Alex (CEO): "Redwood: production-first inference that makes latency, cost, and portability predictable." Keep it under 12 words.
Maya (Head of Product): Can we add a short differentiator line about fallbacks and cost controls?
Ravi (CTO): Suggest: "Automatic model fallbacks, intelligent batching, and token-level cost visibility."
Jordan (Growth): Great. Will use both lines in outreach. Any guidance on messaging about customers bringing their own models?
Alex (CEO): Be clear: bring your model or use ours; we handle serving and ops. Focus on reduced engineering work and measurable unit-cost wins.
Maya (Head of Product): Roadmap shout: SLA FAQ + Console cost widgets landing in ~4 weeks.
allhands-bot: Reminder: feedback survey in #announcements (please complete).
